content:
jordan: FYI on-prem customer reported their 'onprem-admin' role lost access to private control plane after last RBAC refactor. They can't reach /admin or read audit logs. Error: 403. Logs attached.

maria: link? any customer id? :eyes:

jordan: cust-id: acme-fin, env: prod-eu-2. Excerpt from control-plane logs:
```
2026-03-19T14:12:03Z ERROR auth: access denied user=onprem-admin role=onprem-admin-role resource=/v1/admin reason="missing binding"
```
Also KMS decrypt failing when trying to fetch secrets:
```
2026-03-19T14:12:04Z ERROR kms: decrypt denied principal=service-account@acme on key=projects/.../customer-key-123 permission=decrypt
```

samir: I think this lines up with my PR #4238 that changed role->group mapping (removed implicit onprem:admins binding). cc @maria

maria: Oof. Did that PR change any KMS IAM? It should not have.

samir: No KMS IAM changes. Only RBAC mapping in control plane config: `role_mappings: { "onprem-admin-role": ["users:..." ] }` — I removed the wildcard group binding. Maybe customer relied on wildcard.

lena: Customer also mentioned a network error initially. I ran `curl -v https://private-control.acme.example/admin/health` and it shows TLS handshake succeeded but 403: Forbidden.

jlee: The KMS error suggests their service account lost kms.cryptoKeyVersions.useToDecrypt. Need to check customer-side KMS IAM and our key policy. Could be our key rotation job re-attached a restrictive policy.

security-bot: Audit log snapshot:
```
entries:
 - ts:2026-03-19T14:12:03Z principal:onprem-admin action:GET /v1/admin result:403 reason:role_binding_not_found
 - ts:2026-03-19T14:12:04Z principal:service-account@acme action:decrypt result:403 reason:permission_denied
```

samir: Proposed immediate remediation:
1) revert role mapping change (PR 4238) to restore implicit onprem group binding (rollback config)
2) add explicit roleBinding for `onprem-admin-role` -> group `onprem:admins` in control-plane config
3) request acme to confirm KMS IAM for service-account includes `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter` on the specific key

maria: Can infra apply 1) now as emergency? We'll coordinate with support before rollback.

ops: I'll run the rollback in a canary: apply to eu region control-plane node set A first. Commands:
```
kubectl -n controlplane set configmap role-mappings --from-file=role-mappings.yaml
kubectl rollout restart deployment/controlplane -n controlplane --selector=region=eu2 --timeout=5m
```
If health checks pass, promote to rest of cluster. I'll watch audit logs.

infra-bot: Deploy started: rollback-role-mapping -> controlplane/eu2/node-set-A

jordan: Support looped in customer and asked them to avoid config changes. Keeping them updated.

maria: After rollback, let's follow up with a postmortem: why did customer rely on implicit binding, document migration steps, update onboarding docs about KMS IAM + role bindings.

samir: I'll open a follow-up PR to make mappings explicit and add an automated test that prevents removing implicit bindings for on-prem tenants.

ops: Rollback succeeded on node-set-A, canary looks good. Rolling to rest now.

infra-bot: Rollout complete across controlplane. Audit logs show 200 for onprem-admin at 14:24:10Z.

jordan: Customer confirmed admin access restored. Closing loop with them.

maria: Great. Filing incident ticket and assigning postmortem owners. :white_check_mark:
